# Hostizzy

> India's premier vacation rental management company. We empower property owners with technology-driven management and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

## About
Hostizzy (brand of Hostsphere India Pvt Ltd) is a vertically integrated hospitality technology company managing 45+ premium vacation rentals across India. We combine professional property management with proprietary technology (HostOS, ResIQ) to maximize owner revenue and guest satisfaction.

## What We Do
- **Full-Service Property Management**: End-to-end vacation rental management including marketing, guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance, and revenue optimization
- **Technology Platform**: HostOS (smart PMS with GST, WhatsApp, AI pricing) and ResIQ (daily operations dashboard) for data-driven hospitality
- **Multi-Channel Distribution**: Properties listed on Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, and direct booking channels
- **Revenue Optimization**: Dynamic pricing, occupancy forecasting, and channel performance analytics
- **Guest Experience**: Curated luxury stays with concierge services, personalized itineraries, and quality assurance

## Products
- **HostOS** (https://hostos.hostizzy.com): Smart property management system with GST invoicing, WhatsApp + Instagram inbox, AI dynamic pricing, guest/owner portals, SignFlow digital agreements, and review automation
- **ResIQ** (https://resiq.hostizzy.com): Daily operations dashboard for managing reservations, payments, guest KYC, and team coordination — with offline-first PWA design for rural India
- **JuxTravel** (https://www.juxtravel.com): Trip-matching discovery for Indian travellers — starts from the trip you want rather than a city and two dates, and surfaces the trade-offs of an independent homestay before you book. Early access open; full launch 1 September 2026.
- **Booking Site** (https://book.hostizzy.com): Direct booking platform for Hostizzy-managed properties

## Key Markets

### Full Management (End-to-End)
Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Sohna, Manesar), Himachal Pradesh (Shimla, Manali, Kasauli, Dharamshala, Bir Billing, Dalhousie), Uttarakhand (Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Mukteshwar, Nainital, Dehradun, Haridwar), Rajasthan (Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Pushkar, Jawai, Ranthambore), Uttar Pradesh, North East India

### Co-Hosting (Revenue Management + Marketing) — Pan India
Goa, Kerala, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and the rest of India

## Detailed Product Information

### HostOS - Smart Property Management System
HostOS is Hostizzy's proprietary smart PMS built specifically for the Indian vacation rental market. It serves as the central management hub for properties across multiple locations, providing a unified interface for bookings, guests, payments, and team operations.

Key capabilities include:
- **Smart Calendar**: Unified booking calendar that syncs availability across all OTAs (Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip) and direct channels in real time, preventing double bookings.
- **WhatsApp + Instagram Inbox**: All guest conversations from WhatsApp and Instagram DMs managed in one unified inbox — the way Indian guests prefer to communicate.
- **GST Invoicing**: Automatic GST-compliant invoicing with CGST/SGST/IGST and HSN codes for every booking, ready for tax filing.
- **Guest Portal**: Self-service check-in, KYC verification, meal pre-ordering, and payment collection via QR code access.
- **Owner Dashboard**: Real-time property performance, revenue tracking, occupancy analytics, and payout visibility for property owners.
- **AI Dynamic Pricing**: Intelligent rate optimization based on demand, seasons, local events, and competitor analysis.
- **SignFlow**: Digital agreements and contracts with WhatsApp OTP verification and e-signature capture.
- **Review Automation**: Automated review collection, negative review gating, and response management across all platforms.
- **Three Portals**: Guest Portal (self-service), Owner Portal (performance dashboards), and Mobile App (coming soon).
- **Go Direct**: Zero-commission direct booking channel vs 15-25% OTA fees, with integrated payment gateway and UPI support.
- **Made in India**: Full GST compliance, UPI payments, WhatsApp-native design, Hindi + English support.

### ResIQ - Daily Operations Dashboard
ResIQ is Hostizzy's staff-facing operations dashboard — not just analytics, but a complete tool for managing the daily reservation lifecycle from enquiry to checkout. Built with an offline-first PWA architecture for properties in areas with poor network connectivity.

Key capabilities include:
- **Reservation Pipeline**: Kanban-style board to track every reservation from enquiry through checkout with drag-and-drop interface.
- **Payment Tracking**: Real-time payment status across multiple methods (UPI, bank transfer, cash) with pending collection alerts and reconciliation.
- **Guest KYC & Documents**: QR-based guest portal for ID verification and document upload, with automatic data deletion after 60 days for compliance.
- **WhatsApp & Email**: Templated communication hub for guest confirmations, check-in instructions, and team coordination.
- **Enquiry & Lead Pipeline**: Multi-stage Kanban to capture and convert enquiries from all channels into confirmed bookings.
- **Business Analytics**: Revenue, occupancy, and channel performance insights for data-driven property decisions.
- **OTA Calendar Sync**: Real-time iCal integration with Airbnb, Booking.com, and other OTAs to prevent double bookings.
- **Smart Automation**: Automated workflows for check-in reminders, payment follow-ups, review requests, and checkout tasks.
- **Works Offline (PWA)**: Progressive Web App with 95+ Lighthouse score — works where networks don't reach, built for rural Indian properties.
- **Three Portals**: Staff RMS (reservation management), Owner Portal (performance visibility), Guest Portal (QR-code self-service).
- **Enterprise Security**: End-to-end encryption, role-based access control (5 levels), auto data cleanup (60-day retention), token-based sessions.

## Host Academy
Hostizzy's Host Academy is an educational initiative designed to elevate the standard of vacation rental hosting across India. The program offers structured training for property owners who want to improve their hosting skills, whether they self-manage or use professional management services.

### Training Programs
- **Hosting Fundamentals**: A beginner course covering property listing optimization, photography tips, pricing strategies, and guest communication best practices
- **Revenue Mastery**: Advanced training on dynamic pricing, seasonal revenue strategies, multi-channel distribution optimization, and competitive analysis
- **Guest Experience Excellence**: Training focused on creating memorable stays through thoughtful amenities, local experience curation, and service recovery techniques
- **Property Compliance**: Guidance on local regulations, tax compliance (GST for vacation rentals), safety standards, and insurance requirements

### Certification
Hostizzy Certified is a Host Improvement Program with three tiers — Bronze Host, Gold Host, and Platinum Host. Certified hosts earn 15-25% higher rates, receive priority support, and are featured in curated marketing campaigns. The certification process involves: Apply Online → Property Audit → Complete Training → Earn Your Badge.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I list my property with Hostizzy?
Simply visit our Contact page or use the Property Lead form. We'll schedule a discovery call to assess your property and recommend the best management plan.

### What are your management fees?
We offer five plans: SmartStart (₹14,999 one-time setup), ChannelPro (₹15K-40K/month channel management), Hybrid Core (18% commission), TotalCare360 (30% profit share for villas), and StayPrime (50-50 split for apartments with full management including staff and consumables).

### Do you handle guest vetting?
Yes, we use strict verification processes across all booking platforms to ensure high-quality guests. ResIQ includes built-in Guest KYC with document verification.

### What happens if a guest damages my property?
We collect security deposits and assist with insurance claims through platforms like Airbnb AirCover.

### Can I use my own property?
Absolutely! You can block dates for personal use anytime through the Owner Portal.

## Detailed Service Plan Features

### SmartStart
One-time onboarding for new hosts entering the vacation rental market. Includes property audit, professional photography, listing creation and optimization across major OTAs, initial pricing strategy, and access to HostOS and ResIQ platforms. Priced at ₹14,999 as a one-time setup fee.

### ChannelPro
Ongoing OTA channel management for hosts who handle operations themselves. Includes multi-channel listing management, calendar synchronization, pricing optimization, booking coordination, and monthly performance reporting. Priced at ₹15,000-40,000/month based on property portfolio size.

### Hybrid Core
Commission-based co-hosting model combining OTA management with direct booking support. Includes everything in ChannelPro plus direct booking channel setup, guest communication handling, and revenue optimization. Charged at 18% of net revenue.

### TotalCare360
Complete villa and farmhouse management with a 30% profit share model. Includes professional operations, marketing, guest communication, housekeeping coordination, maintenance management, revenue optimization, and dedicated property manager assignment.

### StayPrime
Full apartment management with a 50-50 revenue split. Includes everything in TotalCare360 plus staff management, consumables, and complete operational responsibility — the owner doesn't need to lift a finger.

## Technology Stack
Hostizzy's technology infrastructure is built on modern, scalable frameworks designed for reliability and performance:

- **Frontend**: Next.js (React), Framer Motion for animations, Tailwind-inspired custom CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js, Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Storage), Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (website), Firebase Hosting (HostOS), Vercel (ResIQ)
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4, custom event tracking
- **Communication**: WhatsApp Business API, automated email systems
- **Payments**: Razorpay integration for direct bookings, UPI support
- **SEO**: next-sitemap, JSON-LD structured data, server-side rendering
- **Channel Management**: API integrations with Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip
- **AI**: OpenAI GPT-5-mini for AI chatbot, revenue estimation, and content generation
- **AI Chatbot**: Conversational assistant on every page — answers questions about services, pricing, locations, and qualifies property leads
